description:
Tailor your resume to every job—without uploading your career history to a server.

Rezumate is a private, on-device ATS resume checker for iPhone. Import a PDF or DOCX resume, paste the job description, and receive clear, actionable feedback before you apply.

CHECK YOUR JOB MATCH

See an ATS-style match score based on keyword coverage, impact, structure, readability, and formatting risk. Understand what is working and what needs attention.

FIND MISSING KEYWORDS

Compare your resume with the job description to identify relevant skills, tools, frameworks, and role-specific terms that may be missing. Tap a missing hard skill you actually have to add it to Skills, or mention it in a bullet you choose. Your ATS match score updates immediately.

STRENGTHEN WEAK BULLETS

Find vague or passive bullet points and receive conservative writing suggestions. Rezumate never invents skills, metrics, qualifications, achievements, or experience.

IMPROVE AND EXPORT

Strengthen supported wording, refresh your score, preview the result, and export a clean, selectable, ATS-friendly PDF.

BUILT FOR PRIVACY

Your resume, job descriptions, analysis, writing suggestions, and saved history are processed locally on your iPhone. No account is required, and your career information is not uploaded to a resume-analysis server.

- Import PDF and DOCX resumes
- Paste and compare any job description
- View an ATS-style resume score
- Review detailed score explanations
- Find matched and missing keywords
- Add missing keywords you confirm you have
- Identify weak bullet points
- Receive truthful writing suggestions
- Check formatting and readability risks
- Save tailored resume variants locally
- Preview and export ATS-friendly PDFs
- Use the app without creating an account

FREE AND LIFETIME PRO

Start free with daily resume analyses, improvements, saved variants, and PDF export. Upgrade once to Lifetime Pro for unlimited access—no recurring subscription or credit packs.

Rezumate provides resume-writing and formatting guidance. It cannot guarantee interviews, job offers, recruiter decisions, or applicant tracking system outcomes. Always review your resume carefully and keep every detail accurate.
promotionalText: Tailor every application privately. Add keywords you actually have, watch your ATS match score update, and export a clean PDF — all on-device.
whatsNew:
Tailor this resume to the job. Add keywords you actually have, place them in Skills or a bullet you choose, and watch the ATS score update — still private on your iPhone.

New
• Tap a missing hard skill you actually have to add it to Skills
• Optionally mention it in an existing bullet you pick
• Role-fit checks for job title and education
• Paste a job description from the clipboard

Improved
• Results now puts keyword tailoring first so you can close gaps faster
• Empty-clipboard warnings appear next to Paste, not behind the tab bar
• Improve Resume still strengthens wording without inventing skills, metrics, or experience
